corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This guidance addresses potential systemic vulnerabilities in the Treasury repo market. Inconsistent risk management in bilateral repos could amplify market stress during periods of volatility. The recommended implementation of haircuts and robust documentation frameworks aims to reduce counterparty exposure and prevent cascading defaults. Market participants using bilateral (non-centrally-cleared) repo must review and update their legal agreements and risk frameworks before the June 2026 deadline.
corrected_fields.market_structure_context: The FAQ addresses non-centrally cleared bilateral repo (NCCBR) market risk management practices, documents requirements for legally enforceable margining agreements, and acknowledges that not all repo transactions will likely be eligible for central clearing as SEC's mandatory central clearing rule amendments are implemented. The guidance is intended to complement central clearing expansion rather than replace it.
